deliberateDepartures.description: Use the common light semantic palette instead of the sample palette. ViewBoxes match each CSS slot rather than the reference canvas or surrounding placement frame. No sample pattern or decorative English copy is carried over because these briefs have different facts. Open contours use 1.6 px; essential connectors use 2.2 px at native target size rather than the scheme’s 2.8-unit reference stroke.
Two-line full Japanese担当 names allow readable 18 px text in the stacked layout. The conditional return path is separately routed on the left and uses the warning role.
The narrow portrait layout puts both destinations side by side beneath the shared confirmation step. The empty object is a return box rather than the scheme’s generic empty chair.
A joined contour enters a labelled publication-condition box; it denotes the dependency rather than an already completed publication.
